opportunities.title: Mini Tanque Elegoo Mars
opportunities.description: Quero reduzir drasticamente o volume de resina utilizado nos meus trabalhos diários com a Elegoo Mars, então preciso de um mini tanque (vat) sob medida. O que busco • Projeto CAD completo (STEP ou STL) do tanque menor, pronto para usinagem ou impressão 3D. • Compatibilidade total com o sistema de fixação original da Mars e com o filme FEP padrão. • Redução de capacidade mantendo o nível de resina suficiente para a área de impressão, sem tocar na tela LCD. Detalhes técnicos essenciais – Estrutura rígida (alumínio, resina impressa ou combinação) que garanta vedação perfeita. – Área do FEP bem tensionada e fácil de substituir, aproveitando parafusos, gaxetas ou abraçadeiras originais sempre que possível. – Posição dos parafusos, ranhuras e abas exatamente alinhadas às medições da Elegoo Mars. – Parede interna inclinada ou chanfrada que facilite o escoamento quando eu for despejar a resina restante. Aceito sugestões de design que aumentem a vida útil do FEP ou melhorem a limpeza, mas o objetivo principal é diminuir o volume interno para economizar resina durante pequenos protótipos. Entregáveis 1. Arquivos 3D (STEP e/ou STL) prontos para fabricação. 2. Desenhos técnicos com dimensões críticas e indicações de tolerância. 3. Lista de materiais recomendados e instruções de montagem/vedação. Quando entregar, farei o teste de encaixe e um print-teste rápido; se tudo encaixar e não houver vazamento, aprovo o trabalho.

opportunities.title: Instagram Account Recovery Help
opportunities.description: My Instagram profile was taken over and, before I noticed, the attacker replaced the linked email / phone information and my username. When I try to log in now, I get redirected to the new credentials they set. I still control one of the original recovery channels (either the old email or phone number—just not both), so we have a foothold to verify ownership. I want to start by getting the Instagram account back online under my control, then harden it so this cannot happen again. If the approach you take also uncovers quick steps to reclaim or secure my WhatsApp, that is a bonus, yet the priority is clearly Instagram first. I’m looking for a cyber-security specialist who has hands-on experience with: • Disputing unauthorized changes directly with Instagram support or via their “My account was hacked” workflow • Bypassing social-engineering roadblocks the attacker may have added (new email confirmation, two-factor prompts, etc.) • Locking the account down afterward: fresh passwords, updated 2FA, device checks, and guidance on best practices You’ll need to walk me through any verification steps in real time, so strong communication is essential. Once access is restored, please deliver a concise post-recovery checklist so I can secure all associated devices and apps.

opportunities.title: Cosy Rental Interior Concepts and renovation possibilities
opportunities.description: I’m close to putting in an offer on a property which will be our holiday property, but first I need to see its full potential. The brief is to imagine the entire home in a warm, cosy style and present that vision clearly enough for me to make a confident purchase decision. You’ll receive the agent’s floor plan, rough measurements and current photos. Using those, I’d like you to develop a complete interior concept that shows how every room could feel—entrance, living areas, kitchen, bedrooms, bathrooms and any outdoor nooks included. Deliverables I’m looking for: • 2-3 mood boards that set the overall palette, finishes and furnishings • An annotated floor plan or layout proposal for the whole property • High-quality interior visuals or 3D renders of key spaces that capture the “welcome-home” atmosphere • A concise materials / furniture summary so I know where budget hotspots might sit Please work in whichever tools you are most comfortable with—SketchUp, Revit, 3ds Max, AutoCAD or similar—as long as the output can be shared as PDFs and high-resolution images. A short video walkthrough is a bonus but not essential. I’m happy to answer questions quickly and can provide feedback for one round of refinements. The end goal is a set of drawings and visuals that lets me, and any future guests, picture stepping into a snug, inviting retreat.

opportunities.title: Unused Steel Water Tower Repair Drawings
opportunities.description: NOTE: DO NOT BID VIA BOTS WITHOUT REVIEWING THE ATTACHED DRAWINGS I have already completed a full FEM analysis and produced repair design calculations for an unused landmark water-tower tank. Your task is to take those calculations, verify that the numbers and assumptions are reflected correctly, and turn them into a concise, permit-ready drawing set. Scope • Every element identified in the calculations must appear in the drawings: roof canopy strengthening, tank-top stiffeners, leg-to-shell connections, bracing repairs, and the attached steel signs. • Show weld sizes, bolt grades and spacing, plate dimensions, gussets, and any member replacements or additions exactly as required for a contractor to fabricate and erect. • Base your detailing on the original tower drawings and the recent site measurements I will supply; no fresh structural analysis is expected beyond cross-checking the supplied figures. • All sheets must be prepared in AutoCAD (DWG) and laid out so they can be stamped for permit submission. If you prefer Robot, STAAD, or similar for quick model checks, that is fine, but the deliverable is the CAD drawing set. Must be a P.E with working knowledge AISC, ASCE, FBC 2023 etc. Timeline I need the completed drawing package—including any additional sheets you see are missing from my current index—within 5 calendar days of award. Deliverable checklist 1. General notes and legend sheet. 2. Plan, elevation, and section views locating every repair. 3. Detail call-outs with weld symbols, bolt schedules, and plate data. 4. Connection details for legs, bracing, and signage. 5. Updated revision table referencing the calculation pages. If you have a strong background in structural-steel rehabilitation and can turn precise calculations into clear, buildable drawings on a tight deadline, I am ready to share the full calculation PDF along with the existing DWGs immediately after we start.

opportunities.title: Enhance AI Movie Scene Realism
opportunities.description: I have already generated the first scene of my AI-driven short film, but it still feels rough. The cuts don’t flow, the digital actor’s performance is too stiff, and—most importantly—the lighting, shadows, and camera motion do not yet match the polished, big-budget look I’m after. I want the scene to land visually like a realistic Hollywood movie, so I need an artist who is comfortable jumping into AI-assisted compositing, relighting, and motion refinement to make that happen. What I can supply: • The current edit (ProRes and an .aep project) • Original AI-generated plates and layer passes (character, background, depth, normal maps) • My prompt notes and reference frames for tone and color What I need back: • A single, re-cut scene with smooth, cohesive transitions • Reworked lighting and shadow passes that ground the actor naturally in the space • Subtle, believable camera movement or virtual steadicam correction that keeps everything cinematic • Project files (After Effects / Resolve / Blender, whichever you use) so I can learn from the adjustments Preferred techniques can include generative fill, rotoscoping, depth-based relighting, or even a bit of Unreal Engine sequencing—whatever gets us to photoreal without sacrificing render time. As long as the final shot looks studio-quality and the character feels alive, I’m happy. If you have a reel that shows similar AI or VFX polish, let’s talk and schedule a quick call so you can dive into the materials right away.

opportunities.title: Crypto Quant Researcher – Proven Pump/Dump & Pre-Breakout Strategy | Existing Bybit Bot
opportunities.description: **Fixed budget: $1,000 USD – All-inclusive | No Advance Payments | No Partial Payments** **Do you already have a working, profitable crypto pump/dump or pre-breakout trading strategy that can be adapted to my existing bot?** I am particularly interested in an existing, independently tested strategy with verifiable results. If you do not have one, you must have proven experience independently researching and developing profitable quantitative trading strategies. **I am NOT looking for a general Python programmer or someone who needs me to provide the trading rules.** ## Project Objective My Bybit USDT perpetual trading bot is already fully operational. I only need a **Python 3.12 strategy detection module/script** that connects to it without changing its existing execution, leverage, risk management or exit logic. The strategy must independently identify genuine LONG and SHORT opportunities, including: - **Intraday pumps/dumps:** Major price movements of approximately 10–50% or more within a day. - **Swing pumps/dumps:** Major directional moves developing over several days, weeks or approximately one month. - **Pre-breakout opportunities:** Accumulation, distribution, liquidity changes and order-flow buildup BEFORE major price movements. - **Short squeezes, liquidation-driven moves, reversals and early trend acceleration.** The priority is **early, executable entries**, not signals after most of the movement has already occurred. ## Your Responsibility – Strategy and Profitability **You take full responsibility for strategy research, development, testing and demonstrating historical profitability.** I will not provide profitable trading rules, indicators, thresholds or signal formulas. You must independently develop or adapt a proven strategy using relevant market data, including tick-level trades, order flow, incremental Level 2 order books, liquidity, volume, open interest, funding and market conditions. Experience with **Binance, Bybit, OKX or comparable exchanges** is accepted. Previous Bybit experience is not mandatory, but **the final module must work and be independently validated on Bybit USDT perpetuals**, including smaller eligible coins. The module must detect intraday opportunities in real time without waiting for M1/M5 candle closes, while also supporting longer-term swing detection. ## Mandatory Historical Performance Verification The completed strategy must pass reproducible, chronological, untouched out-of-sample testing with realistic fees, spread, slippage, liquidity and execution constraints. **Binding acceptance requirements:** - Profit factor **≥ 1.5 separately for LONG and SHORT**. - Positive net expectancy for both directions. - At least **100 independent closed out-of-sample trades per direction**. - Maximum portfolio drawdown **≤ 15%**. - Positive net performance after removing the five largest winning trades. - Evidence of early detection, false signals, missed major moves and each filter's actual contribution. Historical tick/L2 data sources, completeness and reconstruction must be verified. Any third-party data costs must fit within the total budget. The project also includes **2–4 weeks of Bybit Demo Trading**, full source code, documentation, reproducible tests and a **10-business-day independent final review**. These are historical acceptance requirements, not guarantees of future profits. ## Existing Bot – Do Not Rebuild My bot already handles execution and risk management. Existing exits remain unchanged: **TP1 closes 20%, TP2 closes 20%, remaining 60% uses ATR Chandelier trailing. No fixed TP3. Break-even only after TP2.** Your deliverable is the independently validated detection module, not a replacement trading bot. ## Payment Terms – Strictly Non-Negotiable **TOTAL FIXED BUDGET: $1,000 USD, ALL-INCLUSIVE.** **NO ADVANCE PAYMENTS.** **NO PAID RESEARCH OR PROTOTYPE STAGES.** **NO PARTIAL PAYMENTS OR PARTIAL MILESTONE RELEASES.** **NO PAYMENT FOR FAILED ACCEPTANCE TESTS.** I can fund **one $1,000 Freelancer escrow milestone upfront as payment security**, but **NO funds will be released until the ENTIRE project has passed independent final acceptance**. If you require partial releases, paid research, advance payments or payment regardless of the agreed historical results, **DO NOT BID**. ## To Apply – Answer Directly 1. Do you already have a profitable, tested pump/dump, pre-breakout or crypto swing strategy that can be adapted? Provide verifiable results. 2. Have you personally developed profitable order-flow or market-microstructure strategies? Show evidence. 3. How will you detect major moves BEFORE the breakout and distinguish real opportunities from false signals? 4. How will you prove historical profitability and obtain reliable Bybit tick/L2 data? 5. Will you take full responsibility for developing and validating the strategy, rather than asking me for trading rules? 6. Do you accept **$1,000 all-inclusive, all historical acceptance criteria, and ZERO payment releases before complete final acceptance? YES or NO.** **Only experienced quantitative strategy researchers with verifiable evidence should apply. Generic bot-development proposals will be rejected.**

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY AND ENVIRONMENTAL CONTINUITY ARE ABSOLUTE REQUIREMENTS. This is a complex, emotionally powerful Christian film—not a slideshow of AI-generated images. We have a complete cinematic storyboard, professional camera blueprint, and visual reference package ready for qualified candidates. TO APPLY Please provide: 1. Your familiarity with the King James Bible. 5. The software and AI video tools you intend to use. Only apply if you can demonstrate the technical ability to deliver this project within our budget and deadline. We're not looking for someone who can simply generate beautiful pictures. We're looking for someone who can BUILD HEAVEN and bring it to life.

opportunities.title: Automatización n8n, IA y CRM para Agencia
opportunities.description: En Agencia WOW estamos buscando un perfil senior hispanohablante especializado en automatización con n8n, IA conversacional y desarrollo no-code/low-code con un fuerte perfil de agencia. Necesitamos un profesional con el know-how operativo de una agencia digital para desarrollar, estructurar y optimizar nuestros propios sistemas internos (que servirán como nuestro principal caso de éxito) y que, posteriormente, se quede integrado en nuestro equipo como colaborador técnico de referencia para los proyectos de nuestros clientes. Fase 1: Alcance del Desarrollo Inicial: - Agente de Voz de Recepción (Entrante): Configuración y optimización de un agente de voz (Vapi o Retell AI conectado a LLMs) que atienda llamadas de la S.L., resuelva dudas frecuentes, cualifique y derive. Es fundamental minimizar y optimizar los costes por llamada, necesitamos que en esta toma de contacto agende automáticamente en Cal.com / Calendly. - Central de Mensajería Multi-canal (Estilo ManyChat propio): Implementación sobre infraestructura propia (VPS) utilizando herramientas open-source como Typebot o Chatwoot integradas con n8n. - Orquestación y CRM: Conexión de todo el flujo anterior a través de n8n (alojado en nuestro VPS) para volcar y actualizar fichas de contactos y oportunidades en el CRM. Fase 2: Colaboración Continua y Comercial (Post-Lanzamiento) Una vez validado el sistema interno, la relación continuará a largo plazo. Requerimos que el candidato aporte: - Su catálogo de servicios técnicos con precios cerrados por implementación. - Su tarifa por hora como colaborador externo para mantenimientos o desarrollos a medida. - Tiempos de respuesta (SLA) y disponibilidad para ejecutar los trabajos. - Capacidad y soltura para reunirse de forma telemática con clientes finales y vender/explicar técnicamente las soluciones haciendo las veces de nuestro equipo de ingeniería. Requisitos Indispensables: - Habla hispana nativa (preferiblemente ubicado en España o países con franja horaria compatible). - Experiencia demostrable en n8n, Vapi/Retell AI, Typebot, APIs/GraphQL y TwentyCRM o CRMs custom. - Experiencia previa trabajando en agencias de marketing digital o automatización (conocimiento de embudos de ventas y campañas de Meta Ads). - Enfoque a optimización de costes y arquitecturas escalables. Para aplicar: Por favor, comparte enlaces a proyectos reales donde hayas implementado agentes de voz combinados con n8n y CRMs, junto con tu propuesta económica inicial para la Fase 1.

opportunities.title: Dramatic Universe Creation Video
opportunities.description: I need a five-minute, story-driven visual journey that begins with an abstract, light-filled interpretation of the Big Bang and ends with the first people walking the Earth, all perfectly timed to the song “So Will I” by Hillsong. Think vibrant streams of glowing particles expanding into swirling galaxies, morphing into oceans, mountains, forests, and finally the pulse of human life—each section hitting key lyrical beats to heighten the drama. The style is deliberately non-literal: no textbook astronomy renders, but rather flowing, luminescent energy forms that suggest cosmic power and divine creativity. Every scene should feel powerful and cinematic, building awe with bold color palettes, dynamic camera moves, and high-impact transitions. Deliverables • 5-minute video mastered in at least 1080p (progressive frame rate) • Clean version and one with the final audio mix in place, synced to the original track’s tempo • Project files (After Effects, Blender, or similar) with all assets properly organized for future tweaks Acceptance Criteria • Visual narrative covers: Big Bang → galaxy formation → Earth’s seas and landscapes → emergence of life → appearance of humanity • Consistent abstract particle/light aesthetic throughout • Pacing aligns with musical crescendos, maintaining a dramatic emotional arc from start to finish • No copyright issues on any supplemental visual assets or SFX used If you thrive on motion graphics, particle simulations, and epic storytelling through light and color, this should be a quick but inspiring challenge.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40796344, publicado hace 17 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: GBP 250 - 750.

opportunities.title: WhatsApp Booking Button Integration
opportunities.description: I want visitors to move from browsing to booking in one tap. The site is not already live only webpage is ready; what’s missing is a floating button that stays visible as they scroll and, when clicked, opens a WhatsApp chat with me. The chat should automatically populate with the specific service or booking type the visitor just chose so they don’t need to re-explain what they want. You’ll handle the full front-end integration—styling the floating button so it matches my site, wiring it to a wa.me or WhatsApp API link, and pulling the selected service name into the pre-filled message. I’ll supply access to the codebase and the list of service labels. Give me back a clean, commented snippet (HTML/CSS/JS or the framework I’m using) plus quick setup instructions so I can drop it straight into production. Once installed, I’ll test on desktop and mobile; if the button floats smoothly and the pre-filled message shows the correct service every time, the job is done.

opportunities.title: Urgent 2D HVAC Layout Drafting TODAY..
opportunities.description: I have a single 30 m × 35 m room served by two identical AHUs, two identical chillers and two identical pumps, all feeding one supply and one return duct. The equipment datasheets are ready, and my base AutoCAD file already shows the room walls, doors, exact equipment positions, ceiling height restrictions and my suggested duct routes with air outlet locations. Your task—starting immediately—is to turn that base file into a clean, final 2D top-view HVAC layout within the next 3–4 hours. The finished drawing must: • keep the existing equipment positions exactly as marked; • complete the supply and return duct network with sizes, air outlets and return grilles; • add all piping routes and connection details between AHUs, chillers and pumps, respecting the ceiling limitations shown; • stay well-layered and ready for printing, delivered as a .dwg plus a quick PDF plot. I will hand over the reference .dwg and datasheets the moment we begin, so you can dive straight into drafting. Speed is critical—please accept only if you can dedicate the next few hours exclusively to this layout and send the finished file back within the stated window. I will share all details my end need only drafting from experts or experience person ..

opportunities.title: Design FitBug’s Cute 3D Companion
opportunities.description: Contest: Design & Rig a Cute 3D AI Wellness Companion for FitBug We are looking for a talented 3D character designer and animator to create a unique, adorable, friendly, and expressive AI companion for FitBug, our upcoming AI-powered health and wellness platform. The character will be an interactive digital companion inside our mobile application, built using React Native, Expo, and TypeScript. What We’re Looking For * Character Design: Cute, lovable, modern, memorable, and suitable for all age groups. * Fully Rigged 3D Model: Complete body and facial rigging with smooth, natural movements. * Exercise Demonstrations: Capable of performing yoga, stretching, gym exercises, walking, and other fitness activities. * Expressions & Emotions: Happy, excited, sad, concerned, encouraging, surprised, and playful. * Talking & Lip Sync: Facial expressions and mouth movements suitable for AI-powered conversations. * Interactive Animations: Waving, dancing, celebrating, listening, thinking, sitting, and reacting to users. * Mobile Optimization: Lightweight, high-performance character compatible with React Native applications. * Extensibility: Ability to add new animations, expressions, outfits, and interactions in the future. Deliverables * Original 3D character design * Fully rigged character with facial controls * Sample exercise, emotion, and talking animations * GLB/glTF or equivalent mobile-compatible format * Editable source files (Blender preferred) * Documentation for integrating and controlling animations programmatically * Full commercial usage rights and ownership of the final original character Contest Submission Please submit your original character concept, along with a short animation demonstrating its personality, expressions, and movements. Our Goal: Create an iconic, emotionally engaging AI wellness companion that users will love interacting with every day. The winning designer may be offered long-term collaboration for additional animations and character development.

opportunities.title: 7-Day Meta Ads campaign for bookings B
opportunities.description: I need an experienced Meta (Facebook & Instagram) advertiser who can jump in today, set up a 7-day campaign, and bring paid traffic straight to my astrology website with a clear “Book Now” call-to-action. The single objective is simple: drive confirmed bookings through the site, NOT calls or WhatsApp chats. You’ll be promoting online astrology sessions, so the ad copy, imagery, and any short-form videos must feel mystical yet trustworthy and encourage visitors to lock in an appointment on the spot. Here’s what I expect: • Strategy outline covering audience selection, placements, and daily spend. • Fully designed creatives (static and/or video) plus persuasive ad copy that aligns with Meta’s policies. • Complete campaign build in Ads Manager, including conversion tracking and any required pixel or event setup. • Daily monitoring and rapid tweaks to maintain performance throughout the 7-day sprint. • A concise wrap-up report with key metrics and recommendations for next steps. All assets have to be ready, and the first ads live within a few hours of kickoff, so only apply if you’re comfortable moving fast and have a proven track record running short-term, conversion-focused campaigns on Meta.

opportunities.title: GoHighLevel AI Sales Automation Expert
opportunities.description: **GOHIGHLEVEL AI AUTOMATION SPECIALIST WANTED | EXPERTS ONLY** We are an established North Texas home improvement company seeking an experienced GoHighLevel specialist to configure an AI-powered sales and lead-management system using HighLevel's existing capabilities. **IMPORTANT: If you are not actively working with GoHighLevel's latest AI features, including Conversation AI, AI Agent Builder, knowledge bases, and advanced workflows, please do not apply.** We need someone who has already deployed working AI sales systems, not someone learning the platform on our project. **ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY** We are looking for a project-based subcontractor to take some workload off our internal development resources, which are currently committed to other projects. We specifically need someone with strong GoHighLevel AI expertise who can implement this efficiently without extensive oversight. **PROJECT REQUIREMENTS** - Facebook and Instagram lead-form integration - AI sales assistant for customer engagement, product questions, and lead qualification - Intelligent, multistage follow-up based on customer responses and project urgency - CRM pipeline organization and automated lead prioritization - Import and reactivation of historical customer inquiries from Google Sheets - Personalized follow-up emails and customer reengagement - Human handoff, notifications, and reporting - Complete testing and operational handoff Our existing Facebook advertising specialist will work directly with the selected contractor. We prefer using GoHighLevel's native features wherever practical. This is a platform implementation project, not a custom software development assignment. **BUDGET AND FUTURE OPPORTUNITIES** We have established an initial budget and are looking for someone who can implement efficiently. Proposals above the posted range may be considered if justified by demonstrated expertise. We have additional projects in our development pipeline and prefer establishing long-term relationships with reliable specialists. Successful performance may lead to future assignments. **IMPORTANT:** A detailed technical scope of work is available as a PDF and should be reviewed before finalizing a proposal. **TO QUALIFY, PLEASE PROVIDE:** 1. Examples of working GoHighLevel AI sales systems you've personally implemented. 2. Which current HighLevel AI features you would use. 3. Your estimated turnaround time. 4. Your fixed-price quote. 5. Any ongoing or third-party costs. **Begin your proposal with "HIGHLEVEL AI SALES SYSTEM" to confirm you've read the requirements.** We are ready to begin immediately with the right specialist.

I am also open to revisions based on your feedback. I would be happy to discuss the project details and get started. Thank you for considering my proposal. Best Regards, AutoCAD 2D Drafting Professional

opportunities.title: Framer Landing Page with Checkout
opportunities.description: Need a Framer landing page for a digital product (US market) — one page + checkout ABOUT THE PROJECT I'm selling a digital product (downloadable files, $67) to buyers in the United States. All traffic comes from Meta ads, and most of it is mobile. I need a single-page site that takes someone from the ad to the payment page in as few taps as possible. This is a small, well-defined project. I already have a full written requirements document, which I'll share with shortlisted freelancers. WHAT I NEED BUILT 1. One long landing page (hero, problem, what's inside, how it works, reviews, product section, guarantee, FAQ, final CTA, footer) 2. A product section with two optional add-on checkboxes and a total that updates live when they're ticked 3. Integration with a payment provider so the CTA goes straight to a one-page checkout — no cart, no popup, no steps in between 4. Thank-you page and a "resend my email" page 5. Six legal pages (privacy, terms, refund, etc.) 6. Email automation setup (Brevo) so the product is delivered automatically after payment 7. Meta Pixel + server-side Conversions API tracking DESIGN I want a dark, modern, premium look — near-black background with deep emerald green glows, lots of depth and subtle motion. I'll share a visual reference. Mobile-first: design for mobile and scale up. I'm specifically looking for designers who can build 3D / motion-heavy sites in Framer — the kind with depth, animated gradients and smooth scroll effects, not a flat template. MUST-HAVES - Real Framer experience (not a template you're reskinning) - Page loads in under 1.5 seconds on mobile, Lighthouse mobile score 90+ - All animations lightweight and hand-built, no heavy plugins - All accounts (hosting, payment, email, domain) created in MY email PLEASE INCLUDE IN YOUR PROPOSAL 1. Your portfolio — live links to sites you've actually built in Framer. Please include at least one with 3D or heavy motion work. 2. Whether you've integrated a payment checkout and email automation before, and which tools you used 3. Your quote and realistic timeline 4. Whether the quote covers the full scope above or design only Proposals without portfolio links won't be considered. Please don't apply if you'll be outsourcing this to someone else — I want to work directly with the person building it.

opportunities.title: Dynamic YouTube Video Editor
opportunities.description: Job title: YouTube Video Editor for AI & Tech Channel — Ongoing Work I’m looking for a video editor for my YouTube channel, Aslam Speaks, covering AI tools, automation tutorials, and practical business applications. Each finished video will be 5–10 minutes long. This is an ongoing opportunity for someone who delivers clear, engaging edits consistently. Editing scope - Remove mistakes, long pauses, and unnecessary repetition. - Combine talking-head footage with screen recordings. - Add zooms, highlights, and simple text callouts to explain key steps. - Use light background music where appropriate. - Balance audio and apply basic colour correction. - Keep tutorials easy to follow without excessive effects. Advanced motion graphics, full animated subtitles, thumbnails, and Shorts are outside the standard scope unless agreed separately. Requirements - Work in DaVinci Resolve or an After Effects-based workflow. - Share relevant YouTube editing samples, preferably tutorials or technology content. - Follow feedback, communicate clearly, and meet agreed deadlines. - State whether you can edit Hindi/Hinglish, English, or both. - Use properly licensed music and assets. Budget and workflow - $10–$20 per completed video, depending on complexity. - Raw footage length, editing requirements, price, and deadline will be agreed before each assignment. - One consolidated revision round per video. - Deliver the finished video in 1080p and provide the editable project files. - We’ll start with one paid trial video. Ongoing work will depend on quality and reliability. To apply, please answer: 1. Share your two most relevant editing samples and explain your contribution. 2. Which editing software do you use? 3. What can you include within $10–$20 per video? 4. What raw footage length does your rate cover? 5. What is your usual turnaround time and weekly availability? 6. Can you edit Hindi/Hinglish, English, or both? Please send relevant examples rather than a generic portfolio.

opportunities.title: AI Chatbot & Automation Developer – Facebook, TikTok, n8n, Google Forms
opportunities.description: ## Project Overview Kaelor Technologies is looking for an experienced AI Chatbot and Workflow Automation Developer for a potential client project in Japan. The client operates or may operate online retail and recruitment-related services. We need a developer capable of designing and implementing an integrated automation system for Facebook Messenger, TikTok, Google Forms, Google Sheets, and business operations. The final scope is subject to client confirmation. We are initially hiring for technical feasibility assessment and a potential MVP implementation, with opportunities for further development. ## 1. Facebook & TikTok Automation - Automatically respond to incoming customer messages. - Handle frequently asked questions and product inquiries. - Collect customer information, order requests, and booking inquiries. - Route complex conversations to human administrators. - Support multilingual communication (Burmese, Japanese, and English). - Assess TikTok Business Messaging API eligibility and integration feasibility. - Use official APIs and platform-compliant integration methods. ## 2. AI Chatbot Development - Evaluate rule-based, AI-powered, and hybrid chatbot approaches. - Integrate OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, or suitable AI services if needed. - Configure knowledge-based responses using approved business information. - Prevent unsupported claims about products, prices, job availability, or application outcomes. - Implement conversation logging, error handling, and human handoff. ## 3. Google Forms & Recruitment Automation - Recreate or improve an existing multilingual Google Form. - Collect job applicant registration information. - Integrate Google Forms with Google Sheets. - Automate application notifications and administrative workflows. - Support basic applicant tracking and status management. - Implement appropriate personal-data security and access controls. ## 4. Online Retail Workflow - Handle product inquiries and customer requests. - Collect order details and customer contact information. - Store and organize order requests. - Notify administrators about new customer inquiries. - Support future integrations with inventory, payment, or order management systems. ## 5. Preferred Technologies - n8n / Make / Zapier - Facebook Messenger API / Meta Webhooks - TikTok Business Messaging API or approved integrations - OpenAI API / Gemini API / Claude API - Google Forms / Google Sheets / Apps Script - Node.js / TypeScript / Python - REST APIs, webhooks, and database integrations We are open to alternative technologies if they are more cost-effective, secure, and maintainable. ## 6. Expected Deliverables - Technical feasibility assessment and architecture proposal - Clear implementation plan with milestones - Working Facebook chatbot MVP - Google Forms and Google Sheets integration - Automation workflows and configuration - Testing and demonstration - Source code / workflow exports - Deployment and handover documentation - Separate TikTok integration estimate after feasibility verification ## 7. Budget & Timeline **Initial MVP Budget: $250–$450 USD** This budget is intended for a limited, clearly defined first implementation, not the complete advanced multi-platform system. Please provide separate quotations for: 1. Technical feasibility assessment 2. Facebook Messenger + Google Forms MVP 3. AI chatbot functionality 4. TikTok integration 5. Additional recruitment and online retail automation 6. Monthly maintenance and third-party services The timeline is negotiable based on the proposed technical approach. ## 8. Application Requirements Please answer the following questions: 1. Have you built and deployed a Facebook Messenger chatbot using official Meta APIs? Provide examples. 2. Have you integrated TikTok Business Messaging? Which API or approved provider did you use? 3. What restrictions or permissions could prevent TikTok integration for a Japan-based business? 4. Have you developed automation using n8n and Google Sheets? 5. Can you build separate workflows for online retail and recruitment? 6. What architecture would you recommend for this project? 7. What can you realistically deliver within $250–$450? 8. What are your estimated timeline and additional operating costs? 9. Can you provide full source code, workflows, documentation, and deployment assistance? Please include relevant portfolio links or demonstrations. We prefer developers with proven production experience rather than generic AI-generated proposals. ## About Kaelor Technologies Kaelor Technologies provides custom software development, AI integration, and business workflow automation solutions. We are interested in establishing long-term relationships with reliable developers for future client projects.

opportunities.title: Reusable n8n CSV to MySQL
opportunities.description: I’m building an automated import flow in n8n and need a reusable workflow that starts from a simple web form where I can upload a CSV. After the file is received, the workflow should parse every row, let me pick which CSV columns map to which MySQL fields through an easy-to-reach settings step (no code edits), and then push the data into the target table. Key behaviour I expect: • If a row is missing required data or contains an invalid value, the workflow should quietly skip that row, continue processing the rest, and keep a clear error log I can download at the end. • All other valid rows go straight into MySQL in a single run. The finished workflow must be easy to clone to new n8n instances and quick to adjust whenever the underlying table or the incoming CSV format changes. Please include brief setup notes so I can drop in my database credentials, point the web-form node to my site, and get rolling without touching the internal logic.

opportunities.title: Desarrollo de Aplicación Web Multiempresa para Gestión de Remunerac...
opportunities.description: Se busca un equipo o desarrollador para crear una aplicación web robusta y segura destinada a una firma jurídica especializada en asesoría de remuneración flexible para empleados. La plataforma debe ser multiempresa, permitiendo el ingreso con roles diferenciados y asegurando el aislamiento de datos entre cada firma. Los módulos clave incluyen: - Ingreso multiempresa con gestión de roles y datos aislados. - Carga masiva de datos de empleados y remuneración desde archivos Excel/CSV, con validaciones integradas para asegurar la integridad de la información. - Configuración de parámetros por empresa, incluyendo proporción de remuneración, menú de beneficios, elegibilidad y reglas vigentes. - Un simulador individual que compare el esquema de remuneración actual con el propuesto, asigne cupos de beneficios y muestre detalles como salario, aportes, retención, ingreso neto, efectivo disponible, beneficios restringidos y ahorros mensuales/anuales. - Generación de reportes individuales en formato PDF/Excel y reportes consolidados. - Un sistema de auditoría completo para registrar cargas, modificaciones, simulaciones y aprobaciones. La firma proporcionará presentaciones y capturas de un simulador anterior como referencia funcional. Es fundamental que las reglas jurídicas y fórmulas, definidas por la firma, sean configurables, versionables y diferenciadas para salario ordinario e integral. Se prefiere el uso de tecnologías como React/TypeScript para el frontend, ASP.NET Core (.net 10 lts) para el backend y postgresql como base de datos, aunque se considerarán alternativas bien justificadas. Dada la naturaleza de los datos (personales y salariales), la seguridad es primordial, requiriendo aislamiento por empresa, permisos por rol, cifrado de datos, auditoría exhaustiva y respaldos regulares. El alojamiento de la aplicación debe ofrecer una tarifa mensual fija, sin cobros automáticos basados en el número de usuarios, simulaciones o consultas, ni autoescalado. Se deberá especificar la capacidad, límites, costo de respaldos y posibles cargos adicionales. La propiedad del código fuente, el acceso al repositorio, las cuentas de despliegue y toda la documentación técnica deben ser transferidos a la firma al finalizar el proyecto. Se solicita incluir en la propuesta la experiencia en el desarrollo de aplicaciones multiempresa, un cronograma detallado y una cotización separada por fases de desarrollo, costos de alojamiento y mantenimiento. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Crear un nuevo sitio personalizado

opportunities.title: Comerciales expertos y responsables de equipos | Fijo + comisiones
opportunities.description: Buscamos comerciales con experiencia demostrable para la venta telefónica de servicios de cumplimiento legal a empresas y autónomos en España. Necesitamos profesionales capaces de generar confianza, resolver objeciones y cerrar contrataciones de manera efectiva. Se establecerán objetivos semanales y mensuales de ventas claros desde el inicio de la colaboración. También existe la oportunidad de incorporarse con un equipo comercial propio o de crear y dirigir uno, cobrando una comisión adicional por las ventas generadas por el equipo. Requisitos clave incluyen experiencia en venta telefónica a empresas en España, español fluido con acento neutro y dicción clara, capacidad para cerrar ventas en la misma llamada, dominio en el manejo de objeciones y recuperación de clientes indecisos, organización, manejo de CRM y una fuerte orientación a resultados. Es indispensable contar con ordenador, auriculares y conexión a internet estable. Se valorará positivamente la experiencia previa en la venta de servicios obligatorios para empresas o consultoría empresarial. Las funciones principales incluyen realizar llamadas comerciales, cerrar ventas, gestionar seguimientos y registrar toda la actividad en el CRM. Para los responsables de equipo, las funciones se extienden a seleccionar, formar, coordinar y acompañar a los comerciales para optimizar sus resultados. Ofrecemos un salario fijo más comisiones por ventas propias, y comisiones adicionales por las ventas del equipo. El trabajo es a distancia, en horario comercial de España, y proporcionamos CRM, guiones y material de apoyo. Se busca una colaboración estable con posibilidades de crecimiento profesional. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Televentas Tiempo requerido: Más de 20 horas

opportunities.title: Videos Financieros Narrativos YouTube
opportunities.description: Necesito producir una serie de videos que capten la atención desde los primeros segundos y mantengan una alta retención para así poder monetizar mi canal. La temática es enseñar economía y finanzas personales a adultos que desean mejorar su situación, pero todo debe ir contado en forma de historias: anécdotas cotidianas, casos reales y ejemplos que emocionen antes de explicar el concepto económico de fondo. Cada pieza debe sentirse profesional y dinámica, con ritmo audiovisual atractivo, subtítulos claros y llamadas a la acción discretas que motiven al espectador a ver otro episodio, suscribirse y compartir. Valoraría el uso de motion graphics sencillos, efectos de sonido ligeros y música de fondo libre de derechos que no opaque la narración. opportunities.title: Gana bien haciendo el bien
opportunities.description: Digpatho (Programa Comercial 2026 – Latino América) es una iniciativa innovadora de Digpatho SAS enfocada en expandir el acceso a la tecnología médica de vanguardia en Latinoamérica. El proyecto tiene como objetivo vincular a médicos y veterinarios con herramientas de diagnóstico avanzadas, impulsadas por inteligencia artificial (IA) y geometría fractal, facilitando de este modo el diagnóstico preciso y el control de inventarios en el sector de la salud. La propuesta comercial está diseñada para personas en Latinoamérica con vocación de relacionamiento y seguimiento, sin que sea un requisito contar con experiencia previa como visitadores médicos. Los colaboradores, que pueden complementar esta labor con sus actividades actuales, se encargan de cerrar ventas mientras que un sistema automatizado de bots asume la mayor parte del trabajo operativo (como la identificación de prospectos). Beneficios y Aspectos Clave de la Oportunidad: • Ingresos Proyectados: Estimación de un ingreso mínimo mensual recurrente de 1500 a 2000 dólares durante el primer año (con base en el cumplimiento de las reglas del reglamento comercial). Dedicación a tiempo parcial. • Seguridad y Transparencia: Todo el esquema de comisiones y el cálculo de pagos se definen formalmente y por escrito mediante un reglamento firmado. El registro de oportunidades se realiza en una plataforma CRM para proteger la cartera de cada colaborador. • Perspectiva de Crecimiento Global: Aunque la convocatoria actual se concentra en el mercado latinoamericano, el proyecto abarca oportunidades de venta en todo el territorio hispanohablante y global. • Incentivo Societario: Dependiendo del desempeño demostrado, existe la posibilidad de acceder a acciones de la compañía, actualmente valorada en 10 millones de dólares y con una proyección de crecimiento exponencial en el corto plazo. En resumen, Digpatho propone un modelo de negocio con propósito, combinando impacto social y un sólido esquema de compensación apoyado en tecnología.

opportunities.title: Diseño Marketplace para Productos de Descanso
opportunities.description: Diseñador Gráfico Freelance para Marketplace (Mercado Libre / Amazon) – 12 imágenes por producto Somos una empresa mexicana con más de 60 años de experiencia en la comercialización de colchones, almohadas y productos para el descanso. Buscamos un diseñador gráfico freelance especializado en e-commerce y marketplaces para colaborar en la creación de contenido visual de nuestros productos. Objetivo del proyecto: Diseñar 12 imágenes profesionales por producto para publicaciones en Mercado Libre, Amazon y otros marketplaces, con un enfoque comercial, creativo y orientado a aumentar las conversiones y las ventas. Requisitos clave: - Lifestyle scenes: Crear escenas realistas y aspiracionales de dormitorios con iluminación natural, decoración elegante y el producto como enfoque principal. - Infografías: Diseñar imágenes informativas con titulares cortos, iconos claros, dimensiones precisas y texto fácil de leer en dispositivos móviles. Todo el copy debe estar en español mexicano. - Fidelidad al producto: Preservar los tejidos originales, acolchado, colores, proporciones, etiquetas y logotipos exactamente como fueron proporcionados. La inteligencia artificial solo se utilizará para ambientaciones sin rediseñar el producto. - Imagen principal: Presentar el producto sobre un fondo blanco puro sin textos promocionales añadidos. - Consistencia: Seguir la identidad visual de cada marca y garantizar que cada imagen tenga un propósito único. Evitar usar una sola plantilla para todas las imágenes. - Precisión: Usar solo especificaciones técnicas confirmadas (capas internas, certificaciones o reclamos deben ser reales). Entregables por lote: - Imágenes .jpg 1200 × 1200 px finales (12 imágenes). - Archivos editables con capas. Proceso de aprobación: Se requiere aprobar primero la imagen principal junto a una infografía clave antes del resto del lote final. Para postularte: Compártenos tu portafolio relevante (incluyendo mercados locales como Mercado Libre/Amazon). Cuéntanos cuánto tiempo aproximas por lote completo tras las revisiones iniciales aprobadas. Preferencia alta por profesionales con especialización comprobada trabajando en categorías hogar/descanso.

opportunities.title: Construcción Tienda Online Moda
opportunities.description: Quiero lanzar una tienda online para vender ropa de mujer de estilo casual y cómoda para el día a día. Necesito a alguien que se encargue de todo el proceso de creación de la tienda, desde la elección y configuración de la plataforma (Shopify, WooCommerce o similar) hasta que el sitio esté listo para recibir pedidos. Alcance esperado • Diseño de una identidad visual coherente con la propuesta “casual-confort”. • Maquetación responsive con una navegación sencilla y fotografías atractivas. • Carga inicial de productos (yo proporcionaré las imágenes y descripciones básicas). • Configuración de pasarelas de pago seguras y métodos de envío estándar. • Integración con redes sociales para facilitar la difusión de lanzamientos y promociones. • Ajustes básicos de SEO on-page y conexión con Google Analytics para seguimiento. Entregables 1. Sitio web funcional publicado en mi dominio. 2. Manual breve (o video) donde pueda ver cómo añadir nuevos productos y gestionar pedidos. 3. Una revisión posterior al lanzamiento para afinar detalles de usabilidad o contenido. Busco a un profesional que tenga experiencia previa montando e-commerce de moda y sepa equilibrar buen diseño con rapidez de carga. Si dominas herramientas de optimización de imágenes, plugins de marketing y prácticas de usabilidad, menciónalo en tu propuesta.

opportunities.title: Contenido TikTok Rehabilitación LCA Hogar
opportunities.description: Quiero convertir la guía de rehabilitación de ligamento cruzado anterior en piezas breves, claras y motivadoras que funcionen en TikTok. El público son personas de cualquier edad con cirugía reciente, así que el lenguaje debe ser sencillo y sin tecnicismos. Alcance del trabajo • Desarrollar un calendario de publicaciones con guiones de 1-2 minutos y textos de apoyo pensados para TikTok (formato vertical, ritmo ágil y dinámico). • Dividir la información en tres grandes etapas: primeras semanas, meses 2-3 y meses 4-6. • Mostrar ejercicios seguros explicados paso a paso como eje principal: calentamiento, rango de movimiento, fortalecimiento y propiocepción, siempre sin equipamiento especial. • Incluir señales de alerta para saber cuándo parar y consultar al médico. • Añadir consejos prácticos de vida diaria (dormir, subir escaleras, uso de calzado, transporte, etc.). • Cerrar cada pieza con recordatorio de que la información es educativa y no sustituye la opinión profesional. Entregables 1. 15 guiones de video (Word o Google Docs) con indicaciones de plano, texto en pantalla y voz en off. 2. 15 textos cortos acompañantes (150 - 200 caracteres) listos para publicarse como descripción y hashtags sugeridos. 3. Un esquema visual por fase que resuma los ejercicios mostrados, útil para futuras infografías. 4. Documento de referencias científicas básicas que respalde la información. Tono y estilo Amable, alentador y empático. Uso de frases breves, emojis moderados y llamadas a la acción que inviten a seguir la serie completa de videos. Para evaluar tu propuesta, comparte ejemplos de trabajos similares: guiones, reels o hilos sobre salud, deporte o temas médicos explicados de forma accesible. Estoy disponible para resolver dudas y ajustar detalles antes de comenzar.

Alcance del trabajo • Desarrollar un calendario de publicaciones con guiones de 1-2 minutos y textos de apoyo pensados para TikTok (formato vertical, ritmo ágil y dinámico). • Dividir la información en tres grandes etapas: primeras semanas, meses 2-3 y meses 4-6. • Mostrar ejercicios seguros explicados paso a paso como eje principal: calentamiento, rango de movimiento, fortalecimiento y propiocepción, siempre sin equipamiento especial. • Incluir señales de alerta para saber cuándo parar y consultar al médico. • Añadir consejos prácticos de vida diaria (dormir, subir escaleras, uso de calzado, transporte, etc.). • Cerrar cada pieza con recordatorio de que la información es educativa y no sustituye la opinión profesional. Entregables 1. 15 guiones de video (Word o Google Docs) con indicaciones de plano, texto en pantalla y voz en off. 2. 15 textos cortos acompañantes (150 - 200 caracteres) listos para publicarse como descripción y hashtags sugeridos. 3. Un esquema visual por fase que resuma los ejercicios mostrados, útil para futuras infografías. 4. Documento de referencias científicas básicas que respalde la información. Tono y estilo Amable, alentador y empático. Uso de frases breves, emojis moderados y llamadas a la acción que inviten a seguir la serie completa de videos. Para evaluar tu propuesta, comparte ejemplos de trabajos similares: guiones, reels o hilos sobre salud, deporte o temas médicos explicados de forma accesible. Estoy disponible para resolver dudas y ajustar detalles antes de comenzar."

Somos un emprendimiento productor y comercializador de **Café Especial de Origen San Agustín / Sur del Huila** con perfilación sensorial avalada por **Catador Q-Grader (+85 a 89 puntos SCA)** y nos comunicamos respecto a **Lanzamiento Amazon US: Visibilidad y Ventas**:

☕ **1. Café Borbón Rosado Tostado y Molido a Medida**: Entregamos en grano entero o con el **nivel exacto de molienda** (fina espresso, media V60/Chemex/filtro, gruesa prensa francesa) y **curva de tostión** (clara, media o media-oscura) que requiera su empresa o cliente (presentaciones de 250g, 500g y bolsas institucionales por kilos con válvula desgasificadora).
📦 **2. Lotes Más Grandes y Microlotes**: Disponibilidad de lotes mayores en pergamino seco seleccionado (humedad 10%-11.5%), café verde tipo exportación o tostado por volumen con trazabilidad directa de vereda en San Agustín (Alto del Obispo, La Estrella, El Tablón, Los Cauchos).
🏅 **3. Calidad Garantizada**: Perfil dulce, limpio, notas a panela, melocotón y flor de café, libre de defectos primarios.

📲 Nuestro WhatsApp directo es **+57 322 273 9034**. ¿A qué dirección o laboratorio les enviamos muestra física y ficha técnica de nuestro Borbón Rosado?

opportunities.title: Comercial B2B Freelance para Automatización Industrial
opportunities.description: TOMEC busca comercial freelance B2B para el sector industrial | Retribución por resultados En TOMEC, empresa de ingeniería especializada en automatización industrial y logística, buscamos incorporar un colaborador comercial freelance para desarrollar nuestra cartera de clientes. Trabajamos en proyectos de automatización, programación PLC, robótica, sistemas de transporte y clasificación, soluciones AMR/ACR y optimización de procesos logísticos, con experiencia en proyectos para grandes empresas como Amazon y otros clientes industriales. ¿Cuál será tu misión? - Identificar empresas industriales con necesidades de automatización. - Contactar con gerentes y responsables de ingeniería, operaciones, mantenimiento y logística. - Generar oportunidades comerciales y concertar reuniones. - Realizar el seguimiento de las oportunidades hasta el cierre de las operaciones, con apoyo técnico de nuestro equipo. ¿Qué buscamos? - Experiencia demostrable en ventas B2B. - Capacidad para captar clientes y abrir nuevas cuentas. - Se valorará especialmente la experiencia comercial en automatización industrial, ingeniería, robótica, intralogística o servicios técnicos. - Autonomía, iniciativa y orientación a resultados. ¿Qué ofrecemos? - Colaboración freelance, sin exclusividad inicial. - Modelo de remuneración basado en resultados, con comisiones vinculadas a las operaciones comerciales. - Apoyo técnico y comercial de TOMEC. - Posibilidad de desarrollar una colaboración estable y ampliar progresivamente el volumen de negocio. Buscamos una persona que sepa abrir puertas en el sector industrial y convertir oportunidades en negocio. Si tienes experiencia comercial B2B y te interesa colaborar con TOMEC, envíanos tu perfil y una breve descripción de tu experiencia, los sectores en los que trabajas y los resultados comerciales que has conseguido.

Trabajamos en proyectos de automatización, programación PLC, robótica, sistemas de transporte y clasificación, soluciones AMR/ACR y optimización de procesos logísticos, con experiencia en proyectos para grandes empresas como Amazon y otros clientes industriales. ¿Cuál será tu misión? - Identificar empresas industriales con necesidades de automatización. - Contactar con gerentes y responsables de ingeniería, operaciones, mantenimiento y logística. - Generar oportunidades comerciales y concertar reuniones. - Realizar el seguimiento de las oportunidades hasta el cierre de las operaciones, con apoyo técnico de nuestro equipo. ¿Qué buscamos? - Experiencia demostrable en ventas B2B. - Capacidad para captar clientes y abrir nuevas cuentas. - Se valorará especialmente la experiencia comercial en automatización industrial, ingeniería, robótica, intralogística o servicios técnicos. - Autonomía, iniciativa y orientación a resultados. ¿Qué ofrecemos? - Colaboración freelance, sin exclusividad inicial. - Modelo de remuneración basado en resultados, con comisiones vinculadas a las operaciones comerciales. - Apoyo técnico y comercial de TOMEC. - Posibilidad de desarrollar una colaboración estable y ampliar progresivamente el volumen de negocio. Buscamos una persona que sepa abrir puertas en el sector industrial y convertir oportunidades en negocio. Si tienes experiencia comercial B2B y te interesa colaborar con TOMEC, envíanos tu perfil y una breve descripción de tu experiencia, los sectores en los que trabajas y los resultados comerciales que has conseguido."

opportunities.title: Offline ETT Workflow Automation Desktop App
opportunities.description: PROJECT: COMPLETE OFFLINE DESKTOP APPLICATION FOR ETT ADMINISTRATIVE AUTOMATION Maximum fixed budget: €300. We are a Spanish temporary employment agency (ETT) looking for a developer to build a complete desktop application to automate our administrative workflow for employees assigned to companies in France. We are not looking for a demo, prototype or basic example. We want the complete application described below, with all the requested processes integrated into one working system. The maximum budget available for this project is €300. Please only submit a proposal if you are willing to work within this budget. 1. EXISTING SOFTWARE AND ACCESS We can provide access to our existing systems: - NominaSOL: We already use this software and can provide access so you can inspect how it works, particularly its Social Security functionality and certificate-based operations. - Amin: This website belongs to our company. We also have a copy of the website available for technical inspection. - We can provide document templates and examples of our current administrative paperwork. We want you to investigate these systems and use available integration methods wherever technically possible. 2. DESKTOP APPLICATION We require an offline-first desktop program installed on our computer or authorised local infrastructure. Requirements: - Desktop graphical interface. - Local database and document storage. - No Google Drive dependency. - Employee management and individual files. - Automated workflow management. - PDF generation and document merging. - Secure handling of employee information. - Complete source code and installation instructions. Local employee management and document processing must work without cloud storage. Internet access will be required for external online operations. 3. EMPLOYEE DOCUMENT PROCESSING AND OCR Our commercial department receives NIE/passport documents and employment information through WhatsApp. The application must allow document uploads and use OCR to extract: - First name and surname. - NIE / identification number. - Expiry date. - Date of birth. - Nationality. - Address, postcode, city and province. - Country and place of birth. - Passport information, where available. Employment start date, French client company and contract duration must also be recorded. Extracted information must be reviewable and editable. 4. EMPLOYEE DATABASE The application must create and maintain individual employee records. It must detect duplicates, reuse existing employees and preserve previous employment assignments and historical documentation without overwriting earlier files. 5. SOCIAL SECURITY AND NAF The application must support NAF consultation using employee identification details and automate the relevant process through the available authorised Social Security integration. It must also process employee registrations through Sistema RED, using the relevant employee information, NAF, start date, Social Security regime and employer CCC. The system must record official responses and clearly distinguish confirmed registrations, rejected operations, pending operations and errors. We can provide NominaSOL access so you can investigate how its existing Social Security connection works. 6. AMIN AND CONTRACT DOCUMENTS The application must connect with our Amin environment where technically possible. It must search for existing employees, reuse their records or create new ones, and generate: - Employment contracts. - Mission contracts (contrat de mission). - CPD documentation, where applicable. Generated documents must be saved as PDFs in the corresponding employee file. You can inspect our Amin website and the copy we own to determine the best integration method. 7. FRANCE POSTING AND A1 The application must manage the information required for employees posted to France, including employee details, Spanish employer information, applicable Social Security regime and CCC, French client company, workplace address and assignment dates. We want the A1 application process automated through the available authorised channels. If online submission fails, the system must save the error or submission receipt and support the alternative manual procedure, including TA300 documentation where applicable. The application must distinguish between an A1 application prepared, submitted, pending, rejected and an officially issued A1 certificate. 8. SIPSI AND FINAL DOCUMENTATION SIPSI information and documentation must be organised within the employee file. The declaration itself may be completed manually if no authorised integration is available. The application must generate and organise the final documentation package, allow PDFs to be merged and prepare the employee file for delivery to the French client. 9. USER INTERFACE We require a clear interface with: - Employee search and database. - Individual employee files. - New employment assignment. - Document upload and OCR. - Social Security and NAF status. - Amin document status. - A1 status. - SIPSI status. - PDF generation and merging. - Error and pending-operation notifications. 10. TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS We are open to your recommended technology. Python/PySide6, SQLite, Tesseract OCR and PDF libraries are possible options. The application must include local storage, basic logging, error handling and backup functionality. All credentials and digital certificates must be handled securely. We will not provide unrestricted access to real certificates or passwords. 11. DELIVERABLES The project must include: - Complete working desktop application. - All requested workflow modules. - Source code. - Installation instructions. - Database structure. - Basic user documentation. - Rights to use and modify the delivered application. Any external integration must be genuinely implemented and tested. Do not describe an operation as automated if it still requires manual execution. 12. FREELANCER PROPOSAL Please explain how you would implement the complete project within our maximum budget of €300. Tell us about your experience with desktop applications, OCR, PDF automation, databases, browser automation and integrations with business software. We can provide access to NominaSOL, our Amin environment and sample documents to help you understand the existing workflow. We are looking for a developer capable of delivering the complete application, not just a visual prototype.
